Number of genes with regionally elevated expression in the **forebrain** - *cerebral cortex, basal ganglia, thalamus, and hypothalamus* in **humans, pigs, and mice**.

Humans had the highest number of genes with regionally elevated expression.

```{r}
human_genes <- sum(180, 83, 57, 110)
pig_genes <- sum(109, 157, 31, 45)
mouse_genes <- sum(55, 185, 60, 98)

print("Number of genes with regionally elevated expression in:")
cat("Humans:", human_genes, "\nPigs:", pig_genes, "\nMice:", mouse_genes)
```
